originality.rationale: The numerical identity Z(Cr_n)=2n-4 is explicitly recognized as covered by Benson et al. (2018), Theorem 2.4 through Cr_n isomorphic to P_2 x K_n. The retained claim is narrower and genuinely additional: all minimum sets are classified by distinct omitted index pairs and counted exactly. Direct inspection of the closest product theorem and counting source did not reveal that classification.
residual_risks: A specialized catalogue or paper may use an uncommon alias for crown graphs and enumerate minimum zero forcing sets without using the searched terminology.

The product theorem is decisive for the scalar equality but not for the retained classification; if an uninspected later paper classifies all minimum sets of P_2 x K_n, originality would need reassessment.
